music_asset_info.title: You Needed Love, I Needed You

caption.text:
Ci ho pensato ma non so dare un titolo, potete sceglierlo voi. 
Buona domenica🤍
caption.text_translation:
I thought about it but I can't give a title, you can choose it.
Happy Sunday🤍
